info.title: Hamqadam AI Identity Verification
info.description: Face, document and fraud analysis for identity verification. Returns a recommendation; the Backend owns the decision.

post.description:
Analyse one submission and return a recommendation.

Every image is optional at the transport layer, deliberately. A missing
one is a finding the pipeline reports rather than a request the API
refuses - the Backend usually still wants the analysis of whatever did
arrive.

Note:
    The multipart body is parsed here rather than declared as `Form`/
    `File` parameters, and the schema Swagger renders comes from
    ``openapi_extra`` above. Two problems forced that, and neither is
    solvable with plain parameter annotations:

    1. Swagger's "Send empty value" checkbox, ticked by default on
       optional file fields, posts an empty **string** for a field the
       user left blank. Declared as ``UploadFile | None`` FastAPI
       refuses the whole request with "Expected UploadFile, received:
       <class 'str'>" - so the documentation page could not submit its
       own form.
    2. Widening the annotation to ``UploadFile | str`` fixed that and
       broke something worse: Swagger renders a union as a *text box*,
       so `secondary_images` became ``array<(string | string)>`` with no
       file picker at all. The upload UI was traded for the ability to
       submit.

    Parsing the form directly gives both: the schema below declares
    honest ``format: binary`` fields, so Swagger shows real file
    pickers and a repeatable selector for `secondary_images`, while the
    parser treats an empty part exactly as an absent one.

verification_id.description: Your identifier for this attempt. Echoed back and used as the log correlation id.

user_reference.description: Your account identifier. Pseudonymised before it reaches a log and never echoed in the response. Also the key the duplicate gallery stores against.

enrol_on_success.description: Optional override. Leave unset and the configured duplicate.enrol_policy decides - this endpoint verifies, checks the gallery and enrols in one call. Pass false to suppress enrolment for this submission. Needs user_reference; without one there is no key to store against. A REJECT is never enrolled.

live_selfie.description: The biometric reference for the whole decision.

secondary_images.description: Additional photographs of the same person.

delete.summary: Erase a face from the duplicate gallery
delete.description:
Erase a stored template.

Idempotent: erasing an absent reference succeeds. A caller retrying an
erasure request must not be told it failed the second time, because
that is how erasure requests get abandoned half-done.

schema.title: Response Forget V1 Duplicate  Reference  Delete

get.summary: How many templates the gallery holds (dev only)
get.description:
Gallery size and which adapter answered.

`store` is the field worth reading: if it says `memory` the gallery is
not durable, whatever the configuration claims.

schema.title: Response Admin Count Admin Qdrant Count Get

get.description:
List references, without vectors.

Bounded by `admin.max_list_limit`: a gallery can hold hundreds of
thousands of records, and an unbounded scan is both a memory problem and
a bulk-disclosure one.

schema.title: Response Admin List Admin Qdrant List Get

get.description: One record's metadata, without its vector.

schema.title: Response Admin Get Admin Qdrant  Reference  Get

delete.description:
Erase a template.

Deliberately the same `forget` call as `DELETE /v1/duplicate/{reference}`
rather than a second deletion path. Testing this therefore tests the
route a real erasure request travels; a parallel implementation could
pass here and leave the compliance one broken.

schema.title: Response Admin Delete Admin Qdrant  Reference  Delete

get.description:
Is this process alive?

Answers yes whenever it can. A liveness probe that fails while models
are loading gets the pod killed and restarted, forever.

Should traffic be sent here?

A different question from liveness, and answering both with the same
endpoint is how a warming-up pod ends up in a crash loop.

Prometheus exposition.

Deliberately unauthenticated and deliberately separate from the API
key: a scrape must keep working when key rotation goes wrong, which is
exactly when the metrics matter most. Expose the port only inside the
cluster.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: Pipeline stage that raised the warning.

AnalysisWarning.title: AnalysisWarning
AnalysisWarning.description:
A non-fatal observation attached to a result.

Warnings are how the service reports "this worked, but you should know
something" - a face near the pose limit, a fallback detector in use, an
optional model unavailable. They never change the outcome on their own but
they feed the fraud engine and give a human reviewer context.

AuthenticityFindingModel.title: AuthenticityFindingModel
AuthenticityFindingModel.description: Something found wrong with the image, and what to do about it.

triggered.title: Triggered
triggered.description: Whether it found what it looks for.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Strength of the evidence for this finding. A low value means weak evidence *for* the finding, not evidence against it.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.description: Raw values behind the verdict. Reported verbatim because these are what an engineer recalibrates against, and because a rejection nobody can explain cannot be appealed.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why the detector could not measure.

measured.title: Measured
measured.description:
Whether the detector produced a usable reading.

Exposed rather than left to the caller to derive from ``note``,
because the distinction matters and is easy to miss: a detector that
stayed silent because it looked and found nothing is telling you
something, and one that could not run at all is not.

AuthenticitySignalModel.title: AuthenticitySignalModel
AuthenticitySignalModel.description: One detector's reading, with the evidence behind it.

x2.title: X2
x2.description: Right edge in source pixels, exclusive.

y2.title: Y2
y2.description: Bottom edge in source pixels, exclusive.

BoundingBoxModel.title: BoundingBoxModel
BoundingBoxModel.description: An axis-aligned face box in source-image pixel coordinates.

success.title: Success
success.description: Whether enough of the card could be read to be usable.

is_cnic.title: Is Cnic
is_cnic.description: Whether the image appears to be a Pakistani CNIC at all. Distinguishes 'a CNIC we could not read' from 'not a CNIC', which need different messages to the user and carry different fraud weight.

father_name.title: Father Name
father_name.description: Father's or husband's name, as printed.

province.title: Province
province.description: Region implied by the identity number's leading digit.

implied_gender.title: Implied Gender
implied_gender.description: Gender implied by the parity of the identity number's final digit - odd is male, even is female. Reported separately from the printed value so the two can be compared.

is_expired.title: Is Expired
is_expired.description: Whether the expiry date has passed. Null when unreadable.

is_lifetime.title: Is Lifetime
is_lifetime.description: Whether the card carries lifetime validity instead of an expiry.

ocr_confidence_score.title: Ocr Confidence Score
ocr_confidence_score.description: Document confidence on the 0-100 scale: a weighted mean over the fields that were read, scaled by completeness and reduced by validation penalties.

field_confidence.title: Field Confidence
field_confidence.description: Mean confidence across the required fields that were read.

completeness.title: Completeness
completeness.description: Share of the six required fields that were read.

fields_missing.title: Fields Missing
fields_missing.description: Which required fields could not be read.

consistent.title: Consistent
consistent.description: Whether the card is internally consistent. False means a cross-field check failed - most usefully, the printed gender disagreeing with the identity number's final digit.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Per-field detail, including confidence and how it was found.

used_fallback_engine.title: Used Fallback Engine
used_fallback_engine.description: Whether the configured primary engine was unavailable.

rotation_applied.title: Rotation Applied
rotation_applied.description: Page rotation applied before recognition, degrees.

preprocessing.title: Preprocessing
preprocessing.description: What was done to the image.

orientation_attempts.title: Orientation Attempts
orientation_attempts.description: How many rotations had to be tried.

gender_cross_check_passed.title: Gender Cross Check Passed
gender_cross_check_passed.description:
Whether the printed gender agrees with the number's final digit.

Null when the comparison could not be made - either value missing, or
the gender having been derived from the number in the first place,
which would make the check circular.

CnicOcrResult.title: CnicOcrResult
CnicOcrResult.description: MODULE 5 output for one CNIC image.

found.title: Found
found.description: Whether a usable portrait was located.

usable.title: Usable
usable.description: Whether the portrait was also good enough to embed. A portrait can be found and still be unusable - an illegible print yields a vector that is not wrong so much as meaningless.

quality_score.title: Quality Score
quality_score.description: Portrait quality on the CNIC scale, which is far laxer than the live-selfie scale. A sub-300-dpi print behind laminate cannot meet a selfie's bar and is not asked to.

has_ghost.title: Has Ghost
has_ghost.description: A second face was found on the card. Expected: modern cards print a faded reproduction of the portrait as a security feature. Not a fraud signal.

foreign_face_count.title: Foreign Face Count
foreign_face_count.description: Faces present that are not plausibly printed on the card - too large, or outside the photo-box region. A card held in front of a face lands here. Not proof of fraud on its own; a poster on the wall behind would also do it.

rectified.title: Rectified
rectified.description: Whether the card was isolated to its own quadrilateral before searching. When true, nothing outside the card was even visible to the detector, which is the strongest form of the containment guarantee.

card_coverage.title: Card Coverage
card_coverage.description: Share of the frame the card occupied.

CnicPortraitResult.title: CnicPortraitResult
CnicPortraitResult.description: Everything the portrait search found on one card image.

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.description: Which pair this relates: profile, secondary or cnic.

compared.title: Compared
compared.description: False when one side was missing or unusable. Distinct from a failed match: 'there was no CNIC portrait' and 'the CNIC portrait is a different person' are opposite findings.

score.title: Score
score.description: Calibrated 0-100 score. Interpolated through the decision boundaries, so 75+ is a strong match and below 50 failed - regardless of which comparison type produced it.

similarity.title: Similarity
similarity.description: Raw cosine similarity in [-1, 1]. The quantity thresholds are applied to. Note that this is NOT a linear function of `score`.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How far this comparison can be relied on. The minimum of the two embeddings' confidences - a comparison is only as good as its weaker side.

low_confidence.title: Low Confidence
low_confidence.description: Whether confidence fell below the configured floor.

target_role.description: Which image was compared against the selfie.

target_label.title: Target Label
target_label.description: Caller-supplied identifier, echoed back for reassociation.

strong_match_threshold.title: Strong Match Threshold
strong_match_threshold.description: The cosine threshold this comparison was judged against.

review_threshold.title: Review Threshold
review_threshold.description: The cosine review boundary for this type.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the comparison could not be made.

ComparisonResult.title: ComparisonResult
ComparisonResult.description: One comparison of the live selfie against another image.

landmarks.title: Landmarks
landmarks.description: Five facial keypoints. Empty when the active detector does not produce them - the OpenCV DNN and Haar fallbacks do not.

face_area_ratio.title: Face Area Ratio
face_area_ratio.description: Face area divided by image area, in [0, 1].

truncation_ratio.title: Truncation Ratio
truncation_ratio.description: Fraction of the face box falling outside the frame.

is_primary.title: Is Primary
is_primary.description: True for the face selected as the subject. Exactly one face in a successful result carries this flag.

is_bystander.title: Is Bystander
is_bystander.description: True for a face small enough relative to the subject to be treated as background rather than a second person.

rejection_reasons.title: Rejection Reasons
rejection_reasons.description: Policy checks this face failed, empty when it passed.

DetectedFaceModel.title: DetectedFaceModel
DetectedFaceModel.description: A single detected face and everything known about it.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: The Backend's own identifier for the matched record, as it was supplied at enrolment. This service stores it opaquely and cannot resolve it to an account.

match_score.title: Match Score
match_score.description: Calibrated 0-100 score, interpolated through this module's own decision boundaries. Not comparable with Module 4's scores: the boundaries differ because the problem does.

is_duplicate.title: Is Duplicate
is_duplicate.description: Whether this candidate cleared the duplicate threshold.

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: Whether it fell in the band between review and duplicate.

enrolled_at.title: Enrolled At
enrolled_at.description: When the matched template was stored.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Whatever the Backend attached at enrolment.

DuplicateCandidate.title: DuplicateCandidate
DuplicateCandidate.description: One enrolled template that resembled the query.

duplicate_found.title: Duplicate Found
duplicate_found.description: Whether any enrolled template cleared the duplicate threshold. Evidence for the Backend's rules engine, not a decision.

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: Whether something fell in the review band: close enough to be worth a human look, not close enough to call.

best_similarity.title: Best Similarity
best_similarity.description: Highest similarity found, or null on an empty gallery.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Nearest templates, best first, including sub-threshold ones.

gallery_size.title: Gallery Size
gallery_size.description: Comparable templates searched. Not a curiosity: a 1:N false-match rate compounds with gallery size, so a similarity cannot be interpreted without knowing how many entries it beat.

searched.title: Searched
searched.description: Whether a search actually ran. False means the gallery was empty or unavailable - which is not the same as finding nothing.

self_excluded.title: Self Excluded
self_excluded.description: Whether the querying user's own template was excluded. Without this a re-verifying user matches themselves at cosine 1.0.

duplicate_threshold.title: Duplicate Threshold
duplicate_threshold.description: Cosine at or above which a hit counts as a duplicate.

review_threshold.title: Review Threshold
review_threshold.description: Cosine at or above which a hit is worth a human look.

thresholds_validated.title: Thresholds Validated
thresholds_validated.description: Whether the operating point has been derived against a real gallery. Always false here. A simulation shows the correct threshold swings from 0.26 to 0.96 across plausible values of a parameter this project cannot measure - see the module doc.

recommended_action.title: Recommended Action
recommended_action.description: proceed, manual_review or reject. A recommendation only.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Recogniser version the query and every candidate share. A search never crosses versions - the scores would be meaningless.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description:
Stable machine-readable error identifiers.

Use :meth:`definition` to obtain the HTTP status, severity, retryability
and default human-readable message for a code.

value.title: Value
value.description: The parsed value, or null when unreadable.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence in this field specifically. Reported per-field rather than only per-document because the fields fail independently - a card can yield a perfect identity number and no gender glyph.

source.title: Source
source.description: How the value was located: `label` when anchored on the card's printed label, `pattern` by shape alone, `chronological` by date ordering, `derived` when inferred from another field.

corrected.title: Corrected
corrected.description: Whether OCR character-confusion correction was needed, which lowers confidence in the reading.

ExtractedField.title: ExtractedField
ExtractedField.description: One field read from the card.

face_detected.title: Face Detected
face_detected.description: True when at least one face passed the acceptance policy.

face_count.title: Face Count
face_count.description: Number of qualifying faces, after the bystander filter. This is the count the single-person rule is applied to.

face_visibility_score.title: Face Visibility Score
face_visibility_score.description: Visibility of the primary face, 0-100. Zero when none was found.

role.description: Which image in the request this describes.

primary_face.description: The face selected as the subject.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: Every face considered, including rejected ones and bystanders.

raw_detection_count.title: Raw Detection Count
raw_detection_count.description: Candidates the detector emitted before the acceptance policy ran. A large gap from face_count means the policy did the work.

detector_version.title: Detector Version
detector_version.description: Pinned version of that adapter's model.

used_fallback.title: Used Fallback
used_fallback.description: True when the configured primary detector was unavailable.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: True when this image satisfies the full detection policy and may proceed to the next pipeline stage.

error_code.description: Why the image failed. Null when `passed` is true.

duration_ms.title: Duration Ms
duration_ms.description: Time spent detecting in this image, in milliseconds.

multiple_faces.title: Multiple Faces
multiple_faces.description: Whether more than one qualifying face is present.

FaceRegion.title: FaceRegion
FaceRegion.description:
Anatomical regions used by the occlusion analyser.

The ordering of :data:`OCCLUSION_REGION_ORDER` is part of the model
contract for the optional ONNX occlusion classifier and must not change
without retraining that model.

capped.title: Capped
capped.description: Whether a configured ceiling reduced it.

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: Code of the strongest finding in the family.

signal_count.title: Signal Count
signal_count.description: Findings in this family. More than one means the extras were treated as the same fact seen again, not as additional evidence.

FamilyContributionModel.title: FamilyContributionModel
FamilyContributionModel.description: What one kind of evidence contributed to the score.

fraud_risk_score.title: Fraud Risk Score
fraud_risk_score.description: 0-100, higher meaning more suspicious. Combined as the strongest finding within each evidence family, then noisy-OR across families - so one fact reported four ways counts once.

top_factors.title: Top Factors
top_factors.description: Finding codes driving the score, strongest first.

assessment_confidence.title: Assessment Confidence
assessment_confidence.description: Share of the intended checks that actually ran. **Not** a confidence that the score is correct - a measure of how much of the evidence was available to compute it.

unavailable_checks.title: Unavailable Checks
unavailable_checks.description: Checks that could not run. These contribute nothing to the score: an absent check is not evidence of innocence, and treating it as such is how a fraud engine gets quietly disabled by an outage.

unrecognised_findings.title: Unrecognised Findings
unrecognised_findings.description: Finding codes with no entry in the catalogue. A gap in this engine rather than a property of the request, surfaced rather than swallowed - an unscored finding is a hole no test would otherwise notice.

floored_by.title: Floored By
floored_by.description: A decisive finding that raised the band regardless of the arithmetic. Null in the shipped configuration; nothing is marked decisive by default.

weights_validated.title: Weights Validated
weights_validated.description: Whether the weights were derived from labelled fraud data. Always false. They are policy - a judgement about how much to care about each finding - not calibration.

FraudRiskResult.title: FraudRiskResult
FraudRiskResult.description: MODULE 9 output for one verification request.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable identifier from the producing module.

family.title: Family
family.description: Which kind of evidence this is. Findings sharing a family are treated as one fact seen several ways and do not compound.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure the producing module was that it fired.

decisive.title: Decisive
decisive.description: Whether this alone raises the band to HIGH.

message.title: Message
message.description: What it means, for a reviewer.

FraudSignalModel.title: FraudSignalModel
FraudSignalModel.description: One piece of evidence, with what it weighed and why.

ImageRole.title: ImageRole
ImageRole.description:
Semantic role of an input image inside a verification request.

The role drives which policy is applied. A CNIC portrait is a low-DPI
print and is held to a laxer quality bar than a live selfie, which is the
biometric reference for the whole decision.

name.title: Name
name.description: One of: left_eye, right_eye, nose_tip, mouth_left, mouth_right. Left and right are from the viewer's perspective.

LandmarkModel.title: LandmarkModel
LandmarkModel.description: One of the five canonical facial keypoints.

MatchDecision.title: MatchDecision
MatchDecision.description: Outcome of a single biometric comparison.

face_match_score.title: Face Match Score
face_match_score.description: Headline match score. The selfie-to-profile comparison where one exists, otherwise the best available selfie-to-photograph comparison.

profile_face_match_score.title: Profile Face Match Score
profile_face_match_score.description: Live selfie against the main profile image.

secondary_face_match_scores.title: Secondary Face Match Scores
secondary_face_match_scores.description: Live selfie against each secondary image, in submission order.

cnic_face_match_score.title: Cnic Face Match Score
cnic_face_match_score.description: Live selfie against the portrait on the CNIC.

identity_confidence_score.title: Identity Confidence Score
identity_confidence_score.description: Fused confidence that the person in the selfie is who the request claims. Null when too few comparisons succeeded for the number to mean anything - which is reported honestly rather than guessed.

identity_available.title: Identity Available
identity_available.description: Whether enough comparisons succeeded to fuse a confidence.

cnic_identity_match.title: Cnic Identity Match
cnic_identity_match.description: Whether the CNIC portrait matched outright. Null when no CNIC comparison was possible.

any_comparison_failed.title: Any Comparison Failed
any_comparison_failed.description: Whether any comparison actively contradicted the identity claim. Distinct from 'not every comparison matched' - a REVIEW outcome is inconclusive, FAILED is positive evidence of a different person.

capped_by.title: Capped By
capped_by.description: Set when a rule limited identity confidence below its computed value; `cnic_failure` when the document comparison failed.

secondary_worst_score.title: Secondary Worst Score
secondary_worst_score.description: The weakest individual secondary score. Reported separately from the aggregate because a single mismatching secondary image is a fraud signal that the mean would dilute.

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.description: Each comparison type's weighted contribution to the fusion.

effective_weights.title: Effective Weights
effective_weights.description: Weights actually applied, after renormalising around unavailable comparisons and down-weighting low-confidence ones.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Recogniser version every comparison used. Comparisons across versions are refused, not attempted.

thresholds_validated.title: Thresholds Validated
thresholds_validated.description: Whether the operating points were derived from a labelled dataset. False means they are engineering defaults from the literature and have not been validated against this deployment's own traffic.

MatchingResult.title: MatchingResult
MatchingResult.description: MODULE 4 output for one verification request.

measured.title: Measured
measured.description: False when this dimension could not be computed - no face for sharpness, no landmarks for geometric distortion. An unmeasured dimension is excluded from the composite, not scored zero.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.description: Raw values behind the score, in their natural units. These are the numbers thresholds are calibrated against.

sub_scores.title: Sub Scores
sub_scores.description: Per-sub-metric normalised scores in [0, 1], before weighting.

MetricDetail.title: MetricDetail
MetricDetail.description: One quality dimension, with the evidence behind its score.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Registry key to pinned version string.

service_version.title: Service Version
service_version.description: Version of the AI service contract.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device family the models ran on.

ModelVersions.title: ModelVersions
ModelVersions.description:
Version of every model that contributed to a result.

Present in every response so a decision can be reproduced later against the
exact artefacts that produced it - a hard requirement for disputing or
auditing a rejected verification.

occluded.title: Occluded
occluded.description: True when overall occlusion exceeds the configured threshold.

overall_score.title: Overall Score
overall_score.description: Weighted occlusion probability across all regions, 0 = clear.

symmetry_delta.title: Symmetry Delta
symmetry_delta.description: Normalised left/right texture asymmetry. A high value with a low overall score is the signature of a hand or object covering one side of the face.

method.title: Method
method.description: 'classifier' when a dedicated ONNX model was used, else 'geometric'.

visible_fraction.title: Visible Fraction
visible_fraction.description: Complement of the overall occlusion score, on the 0-100 scale.

OcclusionReport.title: OcclusionReport
OcclusionReport.description: Aggregate occlusion analysis for one face.

box.description: Face bounds, in the coordinates of the image searched.

area_ratio.title: Area Ratio
area_ratio.description: Face area as a fraction of the card image. Bounded by physical proportion: an ID-1 photo box is a fixed size, so a printed portrait's face occupies a bounded share of the card at any capture resolution.

band_score.title: Band Score
band_score.description: How squarely the face sits in a template photo-box band; 1.0 inside, falling to 0.0 outside the tolerance.

plausibility.title: Plausibility
plausibility.description: Combined rank score used to choose between candidates.

rejections.title: Rejections
rejections.description: Why this face cannot be the portrait. Empty means it can.

PortraitCandidateModel.title: PortraitCandidateModel
PortraitCandidateModel.description: One face considered as the card's printed portrait.

frontal.title: Frontal
frontal.description: True when every axis is inside the configured soft limit.

within_hard_limits.title: Within Hard Limits
within_hard_limits.description: True when every axis is inside the hard limit. False means the face is unusable for recognition, not merely imperfect.

deviation_score.title: Deviation Score
deviation_score.description: Normalised distance from frontal, 0 = perfectly frontal, 1 = at or beyond the hard limit on some axis.

method.title: Method
method.description: How the pose was derived: 'pnp' or 'landmark_geometry'.

reprojection_error.title: Reprojection Error
reprojection_error.description: Mean landmark reprojection error in pixels for the PnP solve. A large value means the solve did not fit and the estimate is less trustworthy.

dominant_axis.title: Dominant Axis
dominant_axis.description: The axis furthest from frontal, for user-facing guidance.

PoseEstimate.title: PoseEstimate
PoseEstimate.description:
Head orientation in degrees, and whether it is within tolerance.

Angles follow the aviation convention applied to a head facing the camera:

* ``yaw`` - rotation about the vertical axis. Positive means the subject
  turned towards the viewer's right.
* ``pitch`` - rotation about the horizontal axis. Positive means the chin
  is raised.
* ``roll`` - in-plane tilt. Positive means the head is tilted so the
  viewer-right eye moves down.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Per-stage duration, call count and average. Stage totals may sum to more than `total` when stages ran concurrently.

overhead.title: Overhead
overhead.description: Time not attributed to any measured stage.

ProcessingTime.title: ProcessingTime
ProcessingTime.description: Wall-clock breakdown of a request, in milliseconds.

usable_as_profile.title: Usable As Profile
usable_as_profile.description: Whether this photograph can serve as a profile picture: a genuine-looking capture, of one person, of adequate quality. A recommendation to the Backend's rules engine, not a decision.

authenticity_score.title: Authenticity Score
authenticity_score.description: 0-100. An upper bound on suspicion, NOT a measure of trust. 100 means four specific tests found nothing - a cropped screenshot or a distant screen capture also scores 100.

is_probably_genuine_capture.title: Is Probably Genuine Capture
is_probably_genuine_capture.description: Whether the authenticity score cleared its threshold. Same caveat: absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Detectors that triggered, strongest evidence first.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Every detector's reading, including the silent ones.

face_detected.title: Face Detected
face_detected.description: Whether a qualifying face was found.

face_count.title: Face Count
face_count.description: How many qualifying faces were found.

is_group_photo.title: Is Group Photo
is_group_photo.description: More than one qualifying face. Not dishonest - but ambiguous about which person the account belongs to.

image_quality_score.title: Image Quality Score
image_quality_score.description: Module 2 composite, on this role's scale.

quality_usable.title: Quality Usable
quality_usable.description: Whether quality cleared this role's bar.

role.description: Which image in the request this is.

ProfileAnalysisResult.title: ProfileAnalysisResult
ProfileAnalysisResult.description: MODULE 7 output for one user-supplied photograph.

resolution_score.title: Resolution Score
resolution_score.description: Genuine as-captured resolution of the face, 0-100.

sharpness_score.title: Sharpness Score
sharpness_score.description: Face-region focus, 0-100. Distinct from whole-image blur.

distortion_score.title: Distortion Score
distortion_score.description: Freedom from posterisation, fringing and stretching, 0-100.

pixelation_score.title: Pixelation Score
pixelation_score.description: Freedom from block artefacts and upscaling, 0-100.

role.description: Which image in the request this describes.

usable.title: Usable
usable.description: True when the image clears its role threshold and every critical floor, and may proceed to the next pipeline stage.

min_required.title: Min Required
min_required.description: Role-specific acceptance threshold this was judged against.

limiting_factor.title: Limiting Factor
limiting_factor.description: The dimension contributing the largest weighted deficit.

critical_failures.title: Critical Failures
critical_failures.description: Dimensions that fell at or below the critical floor. Any entry here makes the image unusable regardless of the composite score.

unmeasured.title: Unmeasured
unmeasured.description: Dimensions that could not be computed for this image.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Every dimension with its raw measurements and sub-scores.

effective_weights.title: Effective Weights
effective_weights.description: Weights actually applied, after renormalising around any unmeasured dimension.

arithmetic_score.title: Arithmetic Score
arithmetic_score.description: The plain weighted mean, for comparison. The composite uses a power mean with exponent < 1, which penalises a single catastrophic dimension instead of averaging it away; publishing both makes that adjustment auditable.

face_analysed.title: Face Analysed
face_analysed.description: Whether a face region was available. Without one, exposure, contrast and noise fall back to whole-image measurement and sharpness is not computed at all.

duration_ms.title: Duration Ms
duration_ms.description: Time spent assessing this image, in milliseconds.

degraded_dimensions.title: Degraded Dimensions
degraded_dimensions.description: Dimensions scoring below 50, for a quick triage view.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation
Recommendation.description: Final AI recommendation returned to the Backend rules engine.

region.description: Which part of the face this describes.

occlusion_probability.title: Occlusion Probability
occlusion_probability.description: Fused probability that this region is obstructed.

occluded.title: Occluded
occluded.description: Whether the probability exceeds the configured threshold.

flat_fraction.title: Flat Fraction
flat_fraction.description: Share of the region whose local gradient falls below half the face-wide median. The dominant occlusion signal: on a real portrait a bare eye measures around 0.06 and a covered one 1.00, and unlike chrominance it detects a skin-coloured occluder.

texture_energy.title: Texture Energy
texture_energy.description: Mean gradient energy of the region relative to the face median. Reported for diagnosis only. It is deliberately not the driver of the occlusion verdict, because a hard-edged occluder raises it through its own boundary gradients.

skin_coverage.title: Skin Coverage
skin_coverage.description: Fraction of the region classified as skin in YCrCb space.

RegionOcclusion.title: RegionOcclusion
RegionOcclusion.description: Occlusion evidence for one anatomical region.

succeeded.title: Succeeded
succeeded.description: Whether it produced a usable result. A stage can run and fail - 'no face detected' is a completed stage with a negative finding.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why it could not run or could not finish.

StageStatus.title: StageStatus
StageStatus.description: Whether one pipeline stage ran, and what it cost.

recommendation.description: APPROVE, REJECT or MANUAL_REVIEW. **Advice, not an outcome** - the Backend's rules engine decides, using context this service does not have.

recommendation_reasons.title: Recommendation Reasons
recommendation_reasons.description: Every condition the recommendation was based on.

automated.title: Automated
automated.description: Whether a rule fired, or the request simply fell through to the default. A reviewer seeing MANUAL_REVIEW needs to know which.

identity_confidence_score.title: Identity Confidence Score
identity_confidence_score.description: Module 4's fused confidence that every image is the same person. ``null`` when no comparison was possible - which is different from zero.

cnic_portrait.description: What Module 6 found on the card. The selfie-to-portrait *comparison* is not here - it lives in ``matching.comparisons`` with every other comparison, because reporting it twice would invite two answers to one question.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: What ran, what did not, and why.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: Whether every intended stage ran. A partial verification still produces a recommendation - it produces a more cautious one.

assessment_confidence.title: Assessment Confidence
assessment_confidence.description: Share of the intended evidence that was available. Not a confidence that the recommendation is right.

model_versions.description: Every model that contributed, so a disputed verification can be reproduced months later against the exact artefacts.

thresholds_validated.title: Thresholds Validated
thresholds_validated.description: Whether the operating points behind this recommendation were derived from labelled data. Always false: Modules 4, 8 and 9 all report their thresholds as unvalidated, because the datasets that would calibrate them are not in this project.

requires_human_review.title: Requires Human Review
requires_human_review.description:
Whether a person needs to look at this.

Exposed rather than left to the caller to derive, because
``recommendation != APPROVE`` is not the same thing: a REJECT that was
automated needs no reviewer, and a MANUAL_REVIEW always does.

VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult
VerificationResult.description:
MODULE 10 output - the complete verification.

The four headline fields the Backend's rules engine reads are
``recommendation``, ``identity_confidence_score``, ``fraud_risk_score`` and
``fraud_risk_level``. Everything else exists so a decision can be explained
to the person it was made about.

detector_confidence.title: Detector Confidence
detector_confidence.description: Raw detector objectness for this face.

face_size.title: Face Size
face_size.description: How well the face fills the frame, relative to the target ratio.

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: 1 - truncation ratio; penalises a face cut off by the frame edge.

limiting_factor.title: Limiting Factor
limiting_factor.description: Component contributing the largest deficit to the composite.

VisibilityBreakdown.title: VisibilityBreakdown
VisibilityBreakdown.description:
Components of the composite face-visibility score.

Exposed in full because ``face_visibility_score`` alone cannot tell a user
whether to move closer, remove their sunglasses or face the camera.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Per-caller API key issued by the Backend. Compared in constant time; the key itself is never written to a log.
ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
